- Baara kɛ ni fɛn o fɛn bɛ sɔrɔ, i n’a fɔ **yiri-cɛncɛn**, **jɛgɛn**, walima **plastiki-tafɛn**.

- Kɛlɛn in sɛbɛn ni **markɛri** ye min tɛ bɔ ni ji ye, wa a tɛ bɔ ni tile ye.

- I bɛ se ka **krayɔn** fana kɛ, walima ka sɛbɛnni kɛ walasa a kana bɔ.
